name: Zanzibar cloves
desc: Whole, sun-dried cloves from Pemba, the island famous for them. A deep aroma for pilau, tea and baking.

name: Cinnamon sticks
desc: Hand-rolled cinnamon bark from Zanzibar’s spice farms. Sweet and warm, for chai and desserts.

name: Black pepper
desc: Whole black peppercorns, bold and fresh. Grind just before serving for the finest flavour.

name: The spice gift box
desc: Six island spices presented in one box: cloves, cinnamon, cardamom, black pepper, nutmeg and ginger. A gift of distinction.

name: Woven ukili basket
desc: Handwoven from palm leaves by women’s groups on Unguja. Each basket is one of a kind.

name: Carved wooden bowl
desc: Carved from a single piece of hardwood by local master craftsmen. For fruit, bread or display.

name: Kanga pair
desc: A matching pair of cotton kangas, each printed with a Swahili saying. To wear, to gift, or to display.

more.Care: Hand wash cold, dry in the shade

name: Kikoi wrap
desc: Soft woven cotton kikoi with tasselled ends. A beach wrap, scarf or towel in one.

name: Linen shirt
desc: A light linen shirt tailored in Stone Town. Cool in the heat, refined in the evening.

more.Fit: Relaxed fit, see the size guide
more.Care: Machine wash cold, iron while damp

name: Football jersey, your club
desc: Pre-order a jersey for your club. Tell us the club and any name or number, and we will confirm availability and the final price on WhatsApp before you pay.

more.Fit: Standard fit, see the size guide
more.Care: Wash inside out in cold water; do not iron the print
more.Note: Genuine jerseys only; we confirm the exact shirt with you first
